title: anthoxanthum nitens subsp. balticum
intro: Anthoxanthum nitens subsp. balticum, commonly known as Baltic bent grass, is a subspecies of grass native to Europe. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Baltic bent grass include reducing inflammation, soothing digestive issues, and supporting the immune system. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
